Maya Patel: Quick proposal — small, repeatable postmortem follow-up timeline + comms cadence + a 'recurrence radar' check. Idea: timebox owners and handoffs so remediations don't stall. :sparkles:

Raj Singh: Love this. can you sketch the timeline? also thinking about how we auto-create the followup tasks. :thinking_face:

Maya Patel: sure — pasted a compact timeline below. aim is to keep each checkpoint <30m overhead for owners. make it a template that the incident bot can instantiate.

Maya Patel: ```
T+0 (incident declared): IC assigned, incident post in #incidents, 30m status cadence
T+24h: RCA draft + 1st remediation owner assignment (owner = IC or designated engineer)
T+72h: Remediation PR(s) opened or mitigation deployed; blocker sync if not
T+7d: Validation run, smoke tests & SLO checks (owner signs off)
T+30d: Recurrence Radar run (run automated detection for similar alerts / error signatures)
T+90d: Retro pulse — check for drift and any reopened/related incidents
```

Sasha Li: the T+30 recurrence radar is interesting — how should that work? naive idea: fingerprint stack traces + metric spikes + request paths and run similarity against historical incidents. if matched, auto-create a followup and ping owners.

Eva Gómez: Agree with fingerprinting. We should also record a small set of regression tests in the RCA ticket so T+7d validation can run automatically in CI. :robot_face:

Chris O'Neill: For comms cadence, can we standardize update windows? e.g., 0/30/60/90 until stable then shift to 2h, 6h, daily. Also add a short note template for status updates (what changed, actions in flight, ETA).

Maya Patel: yes — proposal: initial 30m cadence until triage complete, then 1h cadence until mitigated, then 4h, then daily. keep updates to 2-3 bullets. template: "Status / Impact / Next steps / Owner ETA"

Raj Singh: automation hooks: when incident closes, incident-bot should create a followup epic in our tracker with the T+24h and T+72h tasks as children and assign placeholders (IC -> owner or a nominated owner). can we add a short slash command like `/incident followup create`?

Maya Patel: I sketched an incident-bot command: `/incident followup create --template=fast-check --owner=@IC --due=24h` will create cards. also consider auto-assigning a secondary owner if primary is >72h overdue.

oncall-bot: Incident 1739999999: followup-epic created -> PROJ-2456. T+24h owner: Maya Patel. T+72h owner: Raj Singh. T+7d validation: Sasha Li.

Sasha Li: A couple of practical rules: (1) ownership should be explicit — if owner doesn't respond in 24h, escalate to team lead; (2) remediations must include a measurable success metric (SLO, error rate delta, or repro reduction).

Eva Gómez: For rotation: rotate IC every 2 weeks; have a small onboarding note for ICs with the template and expected comms. Also include a 'handoff checklist' on the T+72h owner card: what to verify, what metrics to watch, who to notify.

Chris O'Neill: can we also surface recurring patterns in the weekly SRE report? Recurrence Radar results should feed a "top recurring incident candidates" section. that would help product/infra prioritize.

Maya Patel: proposed immediate actions (low effort):
- Add the timeline template to the incident runbook (Maya) — due in 48h
- Wire the incident-bot `/incident followup create` command and default template (Raj) — prototype in 5 working days
- Add recurrence-radar job to nightly infra reports (Sasha & Eva) — spike in 10 days
- Create validation CI job scaffold inside RCA template (Chris) — due in 7 days

Raj Singh: I'll take the bot prototype. can you add a minimal JSON payload for template creation? I'll wire it to the bot.

Maya Patel: pasted a compact payload below (can be copy/paste into bot prototype):

Maya Patel: ```json
{
  "template": "fast-check",
  "tasks": [
    {"title": "RCA draft", "due_hours": 24, "assignee": "{{IC}}"},
    {"title": "Remediation PR", "due_hours": 72, "assignee": "{{owner}}"},
    {"title": "Validation & smoke tests", "due_hours": 168, "assignee": "{{validator}}"}
  ],
  "post_actions": ["create_epic", "notify_channel:#incidents"]
}
```

Sasha Li: nice. make sure the payload supports an `escalation_policy` field so the bot can reassign after timeout.

Eva Gómez: small UX note — when bot creates followups, pin the epic link in the original incident thread and add a short checklist table in the incident post. makes it easier to close the loop.

Chris O'Neill: +1. Also request: include a "regression test snippet" checkbox in the RCA so devs can paste CI job names. that will make T+7d validation smoother.

Maya Patel: final ask: can we trial this process on the next 2 priority incidents and iterate? if people agree I'll open the runbook PR and the bot ticket now. :+1:

Raj Singh: thumbs up, will start prototype.

Sasha Li: ok by me.

Eva Gómez: go for it.

Chris O'Neill: +1 from infra.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: T+24h check for incident 1739999999 (owner: Maya Patel)

Maya Patel: thanks everyone — I'll open the PR and post the runbook link here when ready. :rocket:
